piece.headline: HAALAND DELIVERS FOR 24 MANAGERS, MARCEL TAKES THE CROWN
piece.decision_of_the_week: Pishu captained João Pedro instead of Haaland. The armband returned 4 against 26. A 22-point swing, and nobody else backed João Pedro. Bold, and costly.

winners.name: Marcel
winners.verdict: Marcel's week was a masterclass. Calvert-Lewin, Haaland, Belloumi and Cherki all arrived, and the Triple Captain paid off. Up 7 places.

winners.name: Vanessa
winners.verdict: Vanessa played the Triple Captain and her Ajayi and Iwobi transfers added 9. Up 5 places. A tidy week's work.

losers.name: Lakshay
losers.verdict: 17 points sat on the bench. Down 4 places. Lakshay's team selection needs a serious look.
